WCT/
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No.
Date March 30, 19 38.
Subject Incident occurring on March 29, 1938, reported by
Virginia Cowper, travel agent.
Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by
At 9.15 a.m. March 30, the undersigned received a
telephone message from Miss Virginia Cowper, travel agent
of 59 Nanking Road, stating that she had information to
impart which might have some connection with the bomb-
throwing incident which took place at the Italian Consulate
at 7.15 p.m. March 29.
Miss Cowper stated that at 6.20 p.m. March 29,
she observed a man, apparently an Oriental, height about
5 ft. 2 ins., shabbily dressed in foreign style long
brown overcoat and cap, outside her office which is
situated at the ground floor, front, of No.59 Nanking
Road. The man passed and repassed the window several
times and Miss Cowper becoming anxious as to his intentions,
locked the office door. The man then ascended the
steps to the office and made an attempt to enter. At this
stage Miss Cowper noticed that he was carrying a cigarette
tin and, frightened, she rose from her chair, at which the
man turned, went down the steps and departed westwards
along Nanking Road. Miss Cowper then left the office
and went to the Palace Hotel where she related the matter
to some friends.
Enquiries show that Miss Cowper has recently
received visits from Japanese in connection with matters
concerning civil aviation and air travel service in China.
D.S. Henchman
D. S.
D. C. (Special Branch)
（批：D.C.(C)）
（批：FILE）
（批：30/3）

WCT/
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.1, 特科
报告
档案号
日期 1938年3月30日。
主题 旅行代理人 Virginia Cowper 报告的发生于1938年3月29日的事件。
制作人 D.S. Henchman 转发人
1938年3月30日上午9时15分，下述签署人接到
南京路59号旅行代理人 Virginia Cowper 小姐的
电话留言，称她有消息要提供，该消息可能与
3月29日晚上7时15分发生在意大利领事馆的投掷炸弹
事件有关。
Cowper 小姐陈述，1938年3月29日下午6时20分，
她观察到一名男子，显然是东方人，身高约
5英尺2英寸，衣着破旧，身穿西式长款
棕色大衣并戴着帽子，在她位于南京路
59号底层正面的办公室外。该男子多次在窗前
来回走动，Cowper 小姐对其意图感到不安，
便锁上了办公室的门。随后该男子走上
通往办公室的台阶并试图进入。在此
阶段，Cowper 小姐注意到他携带着一个香烟盒，因受惊，
她从椅子上站起来，此时该男子转身，走下台阶并向西
沿南京路离去。随后 Cowper 小姐离开办公室
前往华懋饭店（Palace Hotel），向一些朋友讲述了此事。
调查显示，Cowper 小姐最近因涉及中国民航
和航空旅行服务的事宜接待过日本人的来访。
D.S. Henchman
D. S.
D. C. (特科)
（批：D.C.(C)）
（批：归档）
（批：30/3）
